verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated SOC 2 framework page describing end-to-end automation, condensing 200+ controls into 8 steps and getting audit-ready quickly, plus platform-wide features covering policy management with auditor-approved templates, continuous evidence collection/monitoring, risk management, and access reviews that together constitute the required Trust Services controls and evidence workflow. There is no explicit distinction between Type I vs Type II support, but the audit-readiness and continuous monitoring framing implies both. Missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II workflow differentiation, independent/hands-on corroboration of SOC 2 program completion.
